_comment: Hand-entered fixtures. Use this for matches no scraper can reach --
a youth camp friendly announced only in a press release, or a fixture
you have confirmed from a source this script does not parse.
Entries go through exactly the same rules as scraped data. In particular:
* OMIT kickoff_utc if the time is not confirmed. The entry becomes an
all-day event. Do not put in an approximate time -- an approximate
time in a calendar is indistinguishable from a real one.
* kickoff_utc must carry an explicit offset (…Z or +03:00). A naive
timestamp is rejected rather than assumed to be UTC.
* opponent_code must be exactly 3 letters and must come from the source,
not from truncating a country name (CHI/CHN, NIG/NGA both collide).
* You must supply either local_date, or kickoff_utc together with
venue_tz. The venue-local date is what the UID is built from.
If a seeded fixture has the same UID as a scraped one, the two are merged
and any disagreement about kickoff time is surfaced as a spanning block
rather than resolved -- which makes this file a useful way to cross-check
a source you do not fully trust.
Set "enabled": true once you add entries.

notes: Entered by hand from the Concacaf match-schedule PDF, 2026-08-11.
Date announced, kickoff time not yet published -- intentionally no kickoff_utc.
